# Host dependencies (the player who preprocesses + hosts + assembles).
# Friends who only play need NOTHING (they open the invite link in a browser).
# The relay uses its own light deps: relay/requirements.txt

# Subtitles
pysubs2>=1.7.0

# Auto-generated subtitles ("auto-subs" option): local transcription with OpenAI Whisper large-v3.
# The model (~3 GB) is downloaded on first use of the option.
openai-whisper

# Source separation (install torch with CUDA support BEFORE this file:
#   pip install torch torchaudio --index-url https://download.pytorch.org/whl/cu124 )
demucs>=4.0.0
soundfile>=0.12.0

# Diarization (needs a HuggingFace token, see .env.example)
pyannote.audio>=3.1
# Used directly by the per-line embedding diarization (--num-speakers). It is usually pulled in
# transitively by pyannote's stack, but declared explicitly because diarize.py imports it directly.
scikit-learn>=1.3

# Local host app + preprocess UI
fastapi>=0.110
uvicorn[standard]>=0.27
python-multipart>=0.0.20
requests>=2.31

# Windows only (skipped elsewhere): triton port used by Whisper's GPU kernels.
# It compiles kernels at runtime with MSVC, so it needs the Visual Studio C++ build
# tools installed — run.bat sets the MSVC environment up automatically (see README).
triton-windows; sys_platform == "win32"
